value.rationale: The distinction between unrestricted proper edge-Kempe equivalence and moves constrained to stay among optimal acyclic edge colorings is mathematically motivated and nontrivial: the known general theorem gives no guaranteed route. Complete connectivity, 119784 optimal configurations and degree distribution furnish a natural exact finite reconfiguration classification for the canonical high-girth Fano incidence cubic graph. No wider theorem is asserted.
